name: prometheus.exporter.oracledb

arguments.name: connection_string
arguments.description: The connection string used to connect to an Oracle Database.

arguments.name: username
arguments.description: The username to use for authentication to the Oracle Database.

arguments.name: password
arguments.description: The password to use for authentication to the Oracle Database.

arguments.name: max_idle_conns
arguments.description: Number of maximum idle connections in the connection pool.

arguments.name: max_open_conns
arguments.description: Number of maximum open connections in the connection pool.

arguments.name: default_metrics
arguments.description: The path to the default metrics file. (TOML format)

arguments.name: custom_metrics
arguments.description: The paths to the custom metrics files. (TOML format)

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
